observations: Large black ribbed plastic water tank.
Logo and text 'GEEPPE' are visible on the side in photo 0.
The tank has a top-mounted access hatch.
The base of the tank shows significant surface staining and discoloration.
The tank is situated outdoors on a paved surface.
Watermark 'PHOTOMARBLE AFRICAN REALITIES' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The material is not rubber; it is a plastic (likely HDPE) water tank. The brand 'GEEPPE' is visible, but the '100% rubber' claim is a material misrepresentation.
The capacity is not explicitly stated on the visible side of the tank in any photo.

risks.risk: The tank may be structurally compromised or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the tank filled with water and a soap bubble test for leaks.

risks.risk: The actual capacity may be significantly lower than 4000 liters.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's capacity rating plate.

risks.risk: The base staining may indicate chemical leaching or poor hygiene.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior bottom of the tank.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the capacity rating plate (usually on the side or base).
Video of the tank being filled with water to check for leaks.
Photo of the interior bottom to assess the condition of the base.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
